# netgear_interface (Data Source)

One switch port, its configuration from `show running-config` and its live state from `show port`.

Ports left entirely at their defaults do not appear in the running config, so the configuration attributes are empty for them while the status attributes are still reported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netgear_interface" "uplink" {
  port = "0/24"
}

output "uplink_link_status" {
  value = data.netgear_interface.uplink.link_status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `port` (String) Port id to look up, in either FASTPATH spelling: `0/1` or `g1`.

### Read-Only

- `admin_status` (String) Administrative status reported by `show port`.
- `description` (String) Port description, empty when the switch has none for it.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the port is administratively up. `false` means the config carries `shutdown`.
- `id` (String) Same value as `port`.
- `lag` (String) Interface id of the LAG the port belongs to, such as `3/1`. Empty when the port stands alone.
- `link_status` (String) Observed link state, `up` or `down`.
- `mtu` (Number) Maximum frame size in bytes. Zero when the port is left at the switch default.
- `pvid` (Number) VLAN untagged ingress traffic is assigned to. Zero when the port is left on the default VLAN.
- `speed` (String) Speed and duplex setting, empty when the port is left at the switch default.
- `tagged_vlans` (Set of Number) The subset of `vlans` the port carries tagged.
- `vlans` (Set of Number) VLANs the port participates in.
